blocks.headline: 6a Die Zahlen 0 bis 20
blocks.bodyEnglish:
These are the numbers from zero to twenty.
You need them for phone numbers and for exercise 6.

blocks.title: Zahlen lesen und sprechen
blocks.bodyEnglish:
14 is vier plus zehn: vierzehn.
16 drops the -s of sechs: sechzehn.
17 drops the -n of sieben: siebzehn.

blocks.explanationEnglish:
The teen numbers join the unit and zehn: drei + zehn = dreizehn.
All teens from 13 to 19 end in -zehn: vierzehn, fünfzehn, siebzehn.
11 and 12 are special words: elf and zwölf.
20 is a new word: zwanzig. The part -und comes only from 21: einundzwanzig.
Trap: ✗ vierundzehn → ✓ vierzehn. The part -und never appears below 21.
blocks.englishBridge: English teen numbers put the unit second: four-teen. German keeps the unit first: vierzehn.

blocks.title: E-Mail-Adresse sagen
blocks.bodyEnglish:
Say @ as ät.
Say . as Punkt, - as minus and _ as Unterstrich.
Then say each letter of the address.

blocks.title: Wie bitte?
blocks.bodyEnglish:
Use these phrases when you do not hear well.
Ask once more, say it is too fast, or say you do not understand.
Then the other person repeats.
blocks.bodyGerman:
Entschuldigung, noch einmal bitte.
Bitte ein bisschen langsamer.
Das verstehe ich nicht.

blocks.sentenceEnglish: And what is your e-mail address?

blocks.headline: 9–12 Die Netzwerk-WG

blocks.bodyEnglish: Anna moves into a shared flat in Munich. Luca welcomes her. Then they ask for her phone number.
